# GitHub Step Summary

Write markdown content to GitHub Step Summary

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | ❌ | — | Optional heading for the summary |
| `markdown` | ✅ | — | Markdown content to display |
| `overwrite` | ❌ | false | Whether to overwrite existing summary or append |
